Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 32

“Happy are the kshatriyas, Partha, who are offered such a battle — an open door to heaven, arrived at unsought.”

Unsought carries the weight here. Arjuna did not engineer this war; it arrived at him. Krishna reframes what feels like a trap as an opportunity that came without being manufactured.
